text.tspan: From the editor at the top down to the wire. Grey arrows point from a file to a file it requires; dashed purple arrows are events. Shared modules have no arrows: boxes list them under "uses", and they list who uses them.
Plain scripts the Node-RED editor loads from resources/: one dialog each. Texts and help come from nodes/locales/en-US/.
